name: Tofu with Cauliflower Rice, Spinach, Tomatoes & Creamy Basil Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium head cauliflower
½ pint grape tomatoes
½ small pkg fresh basil
1 (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Add oil and spices to the bowl with the cauliflower, then stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Large dice tofu. Return to the baking sheet; drizzle with oil, season with spices, then toss to coat. Spread tofu out in an even layer over one half of the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tsp onion powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add cauliflower rice to the other half of the baking sheet, spreading it out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until rice is tender and tofu is golden, 13-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add additional oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes start to burst, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the tomatoes are cooking, finely grate Parmesan.

Add Parmesan, broth, cream, and garlic powder to the skillet; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the sauce is done, add basil and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice, tofu, and sauce between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
